description: Curated signatures merged into the scobelix signature database: the ABIs (functions with outputs and mutability, events with indexed flags, custom errors) of OpenZeppelin Contracts 4.9.6 and 5.0.2-5.6.1 (standard interfaces ERC-20/165/721/1155/1271/1363/2612/2981/3156/4626/4906/5267/5805/6093/6372/6909/... and library contracts), of WETH9, Uniswap V2/V3, Multicall3, Chainlink aggregators, ERC-3009, Compound cTokens, Aave V3 pools and Safe, plus the compiler-generated Error(string) and Panic(uint256). Only interface descriptions are kept (names, parameter names and types, indexed flags, outputs, mutability), no source code; OpenZeppelin Contracts is released under the MIT License.
